extDescription.message: Save photos and videos from social platforms into folders on your computer. Files you already have are not downloaded again.

downloadAllHint.message: Download what is new. Stops listing at the first page that is already on disk.

fullScanHint.message: List every page and download anything that is missing.

cardNotManaged.message: This account has no folder yet. The first download sets one up.

noteFolderMissing.message: The folder was not found on the last run.

noteNeedsFullScan.message: The last run did not finish. The next run lists every page.

noteStopped.message: The platform ended the last run.

statusResolving.message: Checking the account and its folder…

forcedFullScan.message: The last run did not finish, so this run lists every page.

noAccountId.message: Could not determine the account id of @$1. Are you logged in?

resultFailed.message: Failed: $1. Details are in the browser console.

resultWillFullScan.message: The next run lists every page to fill what is missing.

retryNotice.message: The platform answered HTTP $1. Retrying in $2 s (attempt $3 of $4).

stopLogin.message: The platform asks you to log in. Requests stopped. ($1)

stopChallenge.message: The platform shows a verification or restriction page. Requests stopped. Open the site and resolve it first. ($1)

stopRateLimited.message: The platform keeps limiting requests. Requests stopped. Try again later. ($1)

stopBudget.message: The hourly request limit of this extension is reached. Try again later. ($1)

stopBadResponse.message: The platform answered in an unexpected form. ($1)

noPicker.message: This browser does not offer the folder picker. In Brave, enable the File System Access API under brave://flags.

permMessage.message: The browser needs your confirmation to write into “$1” again.

pickRootMessage.message: Accounts you download for the first time get a folder named after the account inside this folder.

rootMissingMessage.message: The download folder “$1” was moved, renamed or deleted. Choose the download folder again.

linkTitle.message: Choose the folder of this account

linkMessage.message: “$1” inside “$2” is a link to another folder. The browser does not open links from inside a folder. Choose this account's folder directly: the real folder, or a symbolic link to it (a Windows junction does not work).

folderMissingMessage.message: The folder of @$1 (“$2”) was moved, renamed or deleted. Nothing was requested or downloaded. Choose where the folder is now.

folderMissingSingle.message: The folder of @$1 (“$2”) was moved, renamed or deleted. To reconnect it, run Download All on the account's profile.

relinkMessage.message: @$1 is on your list with the folder “$2”, but the browser no longer holds access to it. Choose that folder again.

wrongFolderTitle.message: No files of this account here

wrongFolderMessage.message: “$1” contains no files of @$2, while the last run counted $3. Using it downloads everything again into this folder.

emptyFolderMessage.message: “$1” held $2 files on the last run and holds none now. Downloading fetches everything again.

postNotFound.message: Could not tell which post this is.

slideNotFound.message: Could not tell which picture of the post is shown. Use the button for the whole post instead.

storyNotFound.message: No stories were returned for this page.

storyCurrentNotFound.message: Could not tell which story is shown. Use “Download all stories” instead.

savedBrowser.message: Handed to the browser's download folder: $1.

savedBrowserFailed.message: Handed to the browser's download folder: $1. Failed: $2.

importIntro.message:
Choose a folder that contains your existing downloads. Its subfolders are searched up to three levels deep for files named by this extension. Only file names are read; nothing is changed.
Folders reached through links are not visible to the browser.

importNothing.message: No downloaded files were found in “$1” (folders read: $2).

importFound.message: Folders with downloaded files: $1 (folders read: $2). Tick the accounts to add to your list.

importTruncated.message: The search stopped after $1 folders. Choose a smaller folder to cover the rest.

importFlagDuplicate.message: This account has files in more than one folder

importFlagOthers.message: Also holds files of other accounts: $1

popupEmpty.message: No accounts yet. Open a profile and press Download All, or import folders you already have.

statusPartial.message: Some files failed on the last run

statusStopped.message: The platform ended the last run

checkIntro.message:
The browser does not tell an extension whether a folder is a link (symlink, junction) or a real folder. This check shows what the browser reports for a folder you pick and compares it with the folders it already knows.
Nothing is written unless you press a test button.

checkLocNone.message: Not inside the download folder or an imported parent folder

checkKindReal.message: Real folder: “$1” opens it through ordinary folders.

checkKindLink.message: Link: its path is inside “$1”, but the browser cannot open “$2” from there. The browser hides links from a folder's listing.

checkKindUnknown.message: Cannot tell. Pick a folder that contains it to compare against.

checkWriteOk.message: Works: a temporary file was created, written, read back and removed.

checkCmpSameEntry.message: The browser treats both as the same folder (same path).

checkCmpSameListing.message: Different paths, identical file names (files: $1). One may be a link to the other; a temporary file can confirm it.

checkMarkerShared.message: Confirmed: a file written through one is visible through the other. Both are the same physical folder, so one is a link to the other.

checkMarkerSeparate.message: Confirmed: two separate folders with equal file names.

checkMarkerFail.message: The temporary file could not be written ($1).

optDevModeHint.message: Shows diagnostic tools in the account panel on profile pages. Currently: “Check a folder”.

optLanguageHint.message: The extension's name and description in the browser's extension list follow the browser's language.

optSaved.message: Saved. Open tabs pick the change up right away.

popupImportHint.message: Adds accounts from folders that already hold downloads. Opens on an Instagram tab, where you pick the folder.

checkExported.message: Handed to the browser's download folder: $1. It holds folder names and account names, no file contents.

checkCopyFailed.message: Could not copy to the clipboard ($1). Use “Export JSON” instead.
